fault_name: Every eligible private-format view creation detaches the original-base alias
scope: Constructed bounded mechanism experiment; no model-path or historical-defect claim
selection_policy: Every call satisfying all predicates is handled; no hit-count suppression or one-shot error
selection_predicates: live registered base object and its storage identity

guards.other_callsite: Registered base, identical requested geometry, different callsite, read-only native view
guards.unregistered_base: Fresh independent unregistered NZ29 base at the same selected entry; real copy_(-16-arange64) then original_base+1

unique_fault_factor: F: actual npu_format_cast(base,2), followed by the original as_strided with unchanged geometry
forbidden_changes: recreating a one-shot injector per invocation
using prior divergence as proof of a later hit

integer_oracle.producer: build_reference.py; Python integers only, no Torch/NPU/view operations

msprobe.alignment: step plus semantic invocation-module/construct path, phase, API kind and callsite; never global API suffix alone
msprobe.null_statistics: UNOBSERVABLE, never equal or numerical failure

causal_interpretation.structural_difference: Every matched CreateView returns a view of a fresh independent F temporary rather than the original base
causal_interpretation.first_call_of_each_fresh_forward: B/F pre-values equal; first observed numerical divergence should arise after write, while reading original base
causal_interpretation.later_calls_on_same_base: Pre-values already differ through prior writes; ReadBaseBefore/CreateView input differences are inherited, not a new earlier fault location
causal_interpretation.per_call_proof: Compare each arm's own pre/post transition and fresh view storage relation; total hits or persistent output difference alone are insufficient
causal_interpretation.statistics_limit: Statistics do not uniquely prove alias break or a native device instruction root cause

execution_order: All B forwards and calls must pass the healthy gate before F begins
warnings: Preserve native warnings and stage markers; do not claim their unique origin without direct evidence
publication: New alias_detach_allhit_statistics_bf_20261028 only; preserve old single-hit implementation and evidence unchanged
